First public release of Henkan, a file converter that lives in the Explorer right-click menu.

## Highlights

- Convert documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, images, audio, video and archives by right-clicking them
- Over 180 conversions, including every Word, Excel and PowerPoint format, PDF/A, merging PDFs, slides to video, H.265 and AV1 video, and TAR.GZ
- Choose which conversions the menu offers and with which settings, and add variants such as MP3 at 320 kbit/s
- Progress as a small card in a screen corner, a window or a Windows notification
- `henkanc`, the same engine on the command line

## Install

Download and run **Henkan-0.0.1-Setup.exe**. If SmartScreen appears, choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

The `.msix` is for Intune and other deployment tools.

## Requirements

- Windows 11, 64-bit
- Microsoft Office or LibreOffice for document conversions

## Third-party components

FFmpeg, Ghostscript and 7-Zip are included. Their source code is in [henkan-bundled-tools](https://github.com/MyDrift-user/henkan-bundled-tools/releases/tag/tools-2026-09).
